query:
SELECT current_setting('TIMEZONE') as server_tz, now() as now_utc, now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima' as now_lima;

SELECT column_name, data_type, udt_name 
FROM information_schema.columns 
WHERE table_name = 'sales_header' AND column_name = 'doc_date';

SELECT 
  doc_date, 
  doc_date::date as date_cast_default,
  (doc_date AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')::date as date_lima
FROM sales_header 
WHERE doc_date IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY doc_date DESC
LIMIT 5;
